annotation.title_clean: Artificial Intelligence - The consequences of artificial intelligence on the (digital) single market, production, consumption, employment and society (own-initiative opinion)
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence - The consequences of artificial intelligence on the (digital) single market, production, consumption, employment and society (own-initiative opinion)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Economic and Social Committee (EESC), INT Section
annotation.summary_en: EESC web page for its 2017 own-initiative opinion on AI's consequences for the single market, production, consumption, employment and society. It only gives a short summary stating AI's potential and risks and calls for a broad societal approach; the opinion text is a separate download.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI offers great potential for innovation, growth, health and climate challenges.
AI carries risks in labour, safety, privacy, ethics and skills.
A broad approach covering all effects of AI on society is crucial.
